name: Study Hall
oracle_text:
{T}: Add {C}.
{1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color. When you spend this mana to cast your commander, scry X, where X is the number of times it's been cast from the command zone this game.
blocked_sentences: {1}, {T}: Add one mana of any color. When you spend this mana to cast your commander, scry X, where X is the number of times it's been cast from the command zone this game.

needs.what: a rider on a mana ability that tags the mana it makes and creates a triggered ability ('When you spend this mana to cast <spell filter>, <effects>') which fires when that tagged mana is spent on a spell matching the filter -- here `is_commander: true` -- with ordinary effects on the stack (scry X, X = `commander_casts_this_game: you`, counted after this cast). The same capability covers Gilanra, Caller of Wirewood, Lapis/Jade Orb of Dragonkind and Scaled Nurturer, whose shipped auto entries currently drop the trigger clause
needs.why_existing_wont_do: A mana ability may hold only add_mana plus the riders add_counters/add_poison/damage/gain_life/lose_life/remove_counters, which happen on activation rather than when the mana is spent and cannot be filtered by the spell it pays for; mana_grant only hands keywords to the permanent the spell becomes; mana_uncounterable only makes that spell uncounterable; mana_restriction narrows what the mana may buy; and no trigger_event observes mana being spent (spell_cast cannot tell which mana paid for the spell). The value commander_casts_this_game already exists, so only the trigger is missing
